text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography version 2021. This source maps the event area as 13.1 ha of native forest, with only 0.4 ha outside mapped forest and no planted forest. This classification is part of the territorial context assessment and does not imply the cause or legality of the change.
